business_summary: AVIC Shenyang Aircraft Company Limited manufactures and markets aviation products in China. It offers aviation defense equipment, military aircraft, and civil aviation products; and aircraft maintenance services. The company was formerly known as Zhonghangheibao Co.,Ltd. AVIC Shenyang Aircraft Company Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Shenyang, China. AVIC Shenyang Aircraft Company Limited is a subsidiary of Aviation Industry Corporation of China,Ltd.
business_summary_ko: AVIC Shenyang Aircraft Company Limited는 중국에서 항공 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 항공 방어 장비, 군용 항공기 및 민간 항공 제품을 제공합니다. 및 항공기 유지보수 서비스. 이 회사는 이전에 Zhonghangheibao Co.,Ltd로 알려졌습니다. AVIC Shenyang Aircraft Company Limited는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 선양에 본사를 두고 있습니다. AVIC Shenyang Aircraft Company Limited는 중국 항공산업공사(Aviation Industry Corporation of China,Ltd)의 자회사입니다.
